description: Ask the YesNoMystery AI host a yes/no deduction question for a puzzle (costs 2 trial credits; 50 free trial credits per anonymous client). Set include_history=true (default) to keep Q&A context across turns, or include_history=false to judge standalone.

history.description: Optional explicit Q&A turns; when omitted and include_history=true, local session history is used automatically

answer.description: The referee answer returned for that question

question.description: A prior yes/no question asked by the player

include_history.description: Whether to include prior Q&A history when judging this question (default true)

locale.description: Language code for the puzzle and AI judgment (defaults to en)

puzzle_id.description: Official puzzle ID/slug or public UGC puzzle UUID/slug

question.description: Yes/no deduction question or hypothesis to ask the AI host

reset_history.description: When true, clear cached local session history for this puzzle before asking

source.description: Optional explicit source hint: official or ugc

name: ynm_ask_question
title: Ask Yes/No Question
